notes: Fixes the repeated Backend Control PIN dialog after a successful PIN entry. The managed Settings UI now waits for the authoritative native grant state instead of prompting from stale startup/cache state; native code rechecks the real current grant immediately before opening a PIN dialog. Deferred Settings entry, Cancel, and stale queued state events are handled without repeated prompts or speculative unlock. Genuine expiry, explicit lock, revoked Control and App access remain enforced by native/server authorization. Existing valid enrollment is preserved: no re-enrollment or credential reset is required for this update. Compatible with the scoped-device protocol in Backend0.36.0-test.38 and later. Prior duplicate-grant-revocation fix retained. No iOS changes; iPad1.0.6 remains incompatible with scoped-device Backend versions. Original Android signing identity retained. All39 non-browser regression scripts including actual Backend HTTP/UI integration and deterministic stale-state reproduction passed; independent focused review passed. Physical Android/Fire Tablet acceptance remains pending.
